# 2026-07-15 — Grants Update

- **[Hearthstone Foundation renewal](../projects/hearthstone-grant.md) is DECLINED.**
  [Diane Alcott](../people/diane-alcott.md) confirmed the foundation will **not** renew the FY27
  grant — it is shifting strategy toward early-childhood funding. **This supersedes the "verbally
  committed / likely" read from the [2026-05-12 board meeting](2026-05-12-spring-board-meeting.md).**
- **Impact:** the restricted grant covered ~half the
  [After-School Tutoring Program](../projects/after-school-tutoring.md) budget — that program's
  funding is now **at risk**. [Robert Kim](../people/robert-kim.md) is modeling the gap.
- **Plan:** [Daniela Cruz](../people/daniela-cruz.md) and Cam to close the gap via the
  [gala](../projects/annual-gala-2026.md), individual major gifts, and a possible re-approach scoped
  to Hearthstone's new focus. [Sarah Chen](../people/sarah-chen.md) wants a plan, not just the news.
- The **Q2 grant report** to Hearthstone is still owed — send it to protect the future relationship.
